exposure: Public development cases; no independent hidden holdout.

cases.prompt: Find promising ways to buy four 1 TB 2.5-inch SATA SSDs for a home server in the United States, at most $200 delivered total. Used is acceptable, delivery within a month, shipping only, no untested lots. Compare feasible channels and explain remaining verification gaps; do not buy anything.
criteria: Preserve four units, SATA 2.5-inch, delivered budget, shipping and tested condition
Consider retail/refurb/used and conditionally surplus; do not recommend unsuitable lots
Inspect at least one concrete page; distinguish stock/asking price/auction bid from a verified delivered offer

cases.prompt: Find a new 1 TB M.2 2280 PCIe NVMe SSD for delivery in Toronto, Canada within 48 hours, under CAD 150 delivered. One drive only, new only, local pickup unavailable. Do not claim address-specific delivery without evidence; do not buy anything.
criteria: Preserve Canadian currency/market, interface/form factor, one/new/urgent constraints
Prefer stock and delivery evidence; avoid wholesale and auction fan-out
State postal-code-specific delivery and total price uncertainty if unverified

cases.prompt: Use the public Codeberg documentation site docs.codeberg.org to find how to protect a branch from direct pushes. Inspect the relevant documentation and state which checks remain uncertain.
criteria: Reach docs.codeberg.org without registering a source
Use primary documentation and inspect exact branch protection support
Keep domain restriction and cite the observed page

cases.prompt: Find public owner discussion of Keychron K2 reliability. Reddit comments and authenticated social access are unavailable. Use only available public web search and page reads, and report the coverage limits; no new accounts.
criteria: Do not require Reddit credentials or claim to read unavailable comments
Use useful available alternatives within limits
Distinguish snippets, inspected firsthand evidence and missing discussion coverage

cases.prompt: Find Japanese-language technical reports about SQLite WAL locking on Zenn or Qiita, and explain one concrete pitfall in English with a link to its original Japanese source. Keep SQLite/WAL identifiers intact and distinguish author reports from official guarantees.
criteria: Use Japanese technical terms while preserving SQLite/WAL
Inspect an original Japanese article on the specified communities
Distinguish original observations from official guarantees and mark translation/version uncertainty

judging: Separate observed task evidence from unmeasured generalization and qualified language correctness. Counts do not establish relevance.
